notes.title: 🎉Celebrating One Year Since Launch with a Major Update!🎉
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44355886/4fe14ea2253bd49603f6fee59bd7b82c37a9c185.png"]


Celebrating One Year Since Launch with a Major Update!
First of all, I want to thank the community for all the incredible support. This game was only completed thanks to you. For those who’ve been here since the beginning, you know how far it has come and how much time it took to fix and polish it.

You might be wondering why some of these improvements—things that probably should’ve been there since day one—took almost a year. The truth is simple: I just wasn’t capable of doing them back then. I didn’t have the experience or the knowledge. It was never about not wanting to do things right. But now, after learning a lot and growing during the development of my new game, I’ve returned to this fan-favorite project to bring it up to the level of quality I aim for in my future titles.

While there are still things that would require a full remake to truly fix (which isn't viable at the moment), I’ve put a huge amount of effort into this update. And without a doubt, you’ll notice the difference in your experience.
[hr][/hr] What's New?
The most noticeable change is the introduction of new key art and updated cover images, along with many fixes and improvements to both gameplay and cutscene animations.

But perhaps the most important addition is the brand-new voice cast. As many of you know, the game originally used AI-generated voices for side characters. While I eventually replaced the main cast with real voice actors, those AI voices still dragged down the experience and often clashed with the performances of the real actors.

Thanks to the support of an incredible team, every main and supporting character now has a real voice performed by talented professionals—bringing the game’s story and emotional moments to life like never before.
New Cast:
Sam – Roo Ryder

Claudia – Ché Grové

Rodrigo – Tavis Leeds

Casting Director – Steve Lloyd

If you’re looking for amazing voice talent, I highly recommend reaching out to this team:


Bone13Productions@gmail.com


[hr][/hr]Full Patch Notes:
Brand-new voice acting for all remaining characters

Improved aiming angles and field of view

Combat is now smoother and more responsive: quicker transitions between melee, dodging, and aiming

Rebalanced combat encounters—less frustrating and more dynamic

Better audio feedback and impact effects for weapons

New locomotion animations for more natural movement

Updated models for supporting characters to match the quality of the protagonists

Improved interaction animations

Enhanced cutscenes and facial expressions

Lighting and environment detail improvements in several scenes

General optimization and performance improvements

Fixed numerous gameplay and visual bugs

Corrected visual glitches

Audio balancing for a more uniform volume experience
[hr][/hr]
Thank you once again for all the support—none of this would’ve been possible without you. I hope this update brings new life to the game and gives you a fresh, polished experience worth revisiting. 🖤

notes.title: Gameplay improvements.
notes.content:
-Fixed a bug that caused tutorials to not display correctly in Portuguese.
- Fixed a bug with the sound of footsteps in some scenarios.
-Removed the option to turn quickly with a joystick, as this only created confusion and moments of frustration when aiming.
-Reduced the speed of the default camera.
-Adjusted the life of an enemy, as this was a recurring complaint due to the large number of hits it took to die.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Bugs are fixed and optimization is improved.

-The bug that caused the camera sensitivity to be reset when loading the game is corrected.
-Fixed the bug where when seeing the sign in the first level, sometimes the camera did not focus on it correctly.
-The location of some key objects has been modified to make it easier to find them.
-Bug fixes and other adjustments and improvements.

notes.title: The final chapters of the game and new voices with real actresses are added.
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44355886/3f6ed623c1ec55e3543b0524f1b47693178a73db.png

This update brings with it a lot of content. The most important thing being the addition of the final chapters where you will know the outcome of Selene's story. With this, some previous scenes and levels are modified and improved.
Another important aspect is the participation of two voice actresses, who will provide voices for Selene and Olivia, since one of the biggest complaints about the game was the use of voices with AI and how they do not transmit any emotion. This is solved with great performances that will give life to the characters. Delaney Gilmore as Selene and Holly Painter as Olivia.

And no less important are the addition of Steam achievements, now you will be able to obtain them by meeting certain requirements, so prepare your weapons and get to work, since it will not be an easy task to obtain them all.

In addition to these aspects, many changes and improvements are made. 
Complete list:

-New levels are added that close the game's story.
- Voice acting is added for the main characters.
-Steam achievements are added.
-Almost all the boss models have been changed, so that they have a better appearance and are more homogeneous with the game. With this, some combats are modified to add freneticism and others are adjusted to achieve fairer and less frustrating combats.
-Some scenes are modified to give the game a better appearance and add to the game's story.
-Combat is improved with better response times with weapons, sounds and visual effects are added to more clearly indicate the impact of hits and shots.
-A new outfit is added for Selene and with this the same outfits are added for Olivia, making them both use the selected outfit, of course, without leaving aside the personality of each one.
-Textures and lighting are improved in some scenarios.
-The volume of all sounds is regulated to have a more uniform sound quality without annoying volume increases.
-Many errors are solved, so many that I no longer remember all of them. D:


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44355886/11f6215563b676a65417b9623aa1d602f78c1e69.png

notes.title: Bug fixes.
notes.content:
Bugs and problems in collisions with scenery are fixed.

Improved occlusion of objects that caused them to disappear when getting too close to a wall. Especially the last level.

notes.title: New movement and adjustments.
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44355886/16582715e6b6c02f682882750ce7a7a7d0579aae.gif

A new movement is added to give more variety to combat and also prevent awkward situations where several enemies hit you at the same time.
This move is a kick that knocks out enemies for a few seconds. Now when you headshot small enemies, they will be stunned for a few seconds and if you decide to approach and interact, you will do this new move. This move will be completely optional, but will be useful to save bullets.


Fixed the error that caused the character to teleport when moving while crouching.

Improved impact reactions of basic enemies.

Fixed bug that caused blood to not stain some important surfaces.

Fixed the issue that caused the camera to not follow the character in some actions.

Other adjustments and fixes.

notes.title: New language for the game: Chinese. and other improvements and adjustments.
notes.content:
The Chinese language is added as an option for the game, this is possible thanks to the BIOHAZARD.CLUB team:
Tianlin Wang
Yicheng Fan

They have taken it upon themselves to provide a free localization. For which I am very grateful.

Other improvements:

Improvements in lighting and optimization of the last level.
FIxed errors with collisions in last level.
Fixed the error that did not leave the settings configuration when loading the game.
More enemies are added.
Fixed aiming issues that caused the character to not aim or sometimes do so even without the button pressed.
Annoying physics are removed.
Improvements in some lines of dialogue.
Optimization is improved in general.
Improvements in character movement.
Other adjustments and bug fixes.
